subject: Invoice delivery preferences: portal enrollment + AP mirror PDF
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@orbithealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@orbithealth.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery / billing contact for Redwood (PO 9921)

Hi Hannah,

We are finalizing the PO for Redwood (PO 9921) and need to confirm how invoices will be delivered to OrbitHealth AP. Procurement asked whether you offer a vendor portal for direct invoice retrieval or if you will send monthly PDFs to our AP mailbox (ap@orbithealth.com).

A couple of constraints from our side:
- Our AP system requires a PDF copy of the invoice that includes your vendor tax ID and the PO number.
- Procurement prefers portal enrollment for easier reconciliation, but our AP team needs an automated email copy or webhook so invoices are picked up automatically.
- VAT evidence: please confirm whether the invoice will include Redwood's VAT registration number and a line for VAT breakdown.

Can you confirm the options and the enrollment timeline? If portal enrollment is faster, we can trigger that — but it would help to have a short onboarding checklist and a one-time sample invoice for our tax team to validate formats.

Thanks,
Lydia Chen
Director, Procurement Operations
OrbitHealth
lydia.chen@orbithealth.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery / billing contact for Redwood (PO 9921)

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear summary. Short answer: both are supported; we can enroll OrbitHealth in the Redwood Billing Portal and also send an automated mirror PDF to ap@orbithealth.com. Below are the trade-offs and the steps we recommend.

Options (high level):
1) Portal primary + AP mirror email (recommended)
   - Portal is the canonical source (displaying line-level tax breakdown, credits, and metadata).
   - At creation time we will also emit a PDF copy to ap@orbithealth.com (can be on every invoice or batched daily).
   - Best for reconciliation and retaining structured metadata for your system (we can include invoice hash and line-level VAT).

2) Email-only delivery (legacy fallback)
   - We send PDFs to a configured mailbox; requires your AP system to parse attachments.
   - Simpler short-term but misses structured metadata and automatic lineage for disputed credits.

Required fields for enroll / sample invoice:
- Vendor name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Vendor tax ID (we will include): US EIN 83-2154129 and EU VAT GB999999973 (if you need a specific local VAT, tell us the country).
- Billing contact name + email for portal invite (single user required to start).
- PO number format (you provided 9921 — confirm whether more than one PO per invoice will occur).

I attached a brief onboarding checklist (portal_onboarding_checklist.xlsx) that Pamela on our onboarding team typically uses; it lists the fields we need to provision your tenant and the expected sequence (invite -> acceptance -> first invoice sync). If you confirm portal + mirror, we can aim to have invites out within 48 business hours and first invoice sync on the next billing cycle.

One more note on VAT: we can include a VAT breakdown line by line and a total VAT amount. If OrbitHealth requires a separate VAT evidence PDF, let us know and we can include a second artifact.

Next steps
- Please confirm: billing contact for invite; whether ap@orbithealth.com should receive every invoice PDF or a daily digest; and whether PO 9921 will be used on the first invoice only or multiple POs per period.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Finance Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hannah — appreciate the options. Procurement would prefer the portal route; AP still requires a copy of every invoice in PDF form. Two clarifications from our AP team (copied here):
- Please include Redwood's tax ID on the face of the PDF (we need it for tax reporting).
- We want the mirror PDF delivered to ap@orbithealth.com immediately at invoice issuance (not a daily digest).

Connor — can Redwood map the invoice PDF filename to include the PO (e.g., Redwood_INV_9921_20270531.pdf) so our ingest rules pick it up automatically?

If portal invites are easy, let's proceed with portal enrollment + immediate PDF mirror. Also: can you share a sample invoice ASAP so our tax folks can confirm the VAT line placement?

Thanks,
Marco Ruiz
Sr. Manager, AP Operations
OrbitHealth
m.ruiz@orbithealth.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Invoice delivery / billing contact for Redwood (PO 9921)

Thanks Marco — can confirm we can: 
- Enroll OrbitHealth in the Redwood Billing Portal and provision an admin invite for the billing contact you provide.
- Emit a PDF copy of each generated invoice to ap@orbithealth.com at the moment of issuance. The filename will follow the pattern Redwood_INV_{PO}_{YYYYMMDD}.pdf by default; we can supply a mapping table if you have a strict naming requirement.

Action items from Redwood (next 48 hours):
1) Portal invite: we need the billing contact email for the initial invite (please provide the person who will accept admin rights).
2) Sample invoice: attached is a close-to-production sample with PO 9921 populated and VAT breakdown (OrbitHealth_sample_invoice_May2027.pdf). Please have your tax team confirm layout.
3) Technical: if you prefer webhook delivery to your AP ingestion endpoint instead of mailbox pickup, send the endpoint and an auth key and we will enable that instead of email.

Once we receive the billing contact and confirmation on filename, we will schedule the invite and set a flag on the account so every invoice emits the mirror PDF.

Best,
